AddColumnToDataSetRequestContent.description: A request to add a column to a data set.

AddColumnToDataSetResponseContent.description: A response containing the updated data set containing the new column.

code.description: The error code associated with the exception.

details.description: The error code associated with the exception.

errors.description: The error message(s) associated with the exception.

requestId.description: The request ID associated with the exception.

Column.description: The definition of a column in a data set.

description.description: Optional. The human-readable description of the purpose of this column.

isCountryCode.description: Optional. If this column is countryCode or not. Default is false.

isMainEventTime.description: Optional. If this column is contains the main event time of the record. Default is false.

isMainUserId.description: Optional. If this column is the resolved user id. Default is false.

isMainUserIdType.description: Optional. If this column should contain the resolved user id type. Default is false.

nullable.description: Optional. If data in this column can be null or not. Default is true.

requiresOneWayHashing.description: Optional. If this column requires one way hashing or not. Default is false.

ColumnType.description: The type of a data set column. There are two types of columns, the column which is a quantity or value rather than a dimension is METRIC. These columns are generally used in queries to perform aggregations. Typical exam…

ComparatorOperator.description: Optional. If a createdAt is provided, a comparator should be provided.

CompressionFormat.description: [UPDATE: As of 01/01/2025, `ZIP` is deprecated]. The compression format of data in S3 bucket.

ConsentType.description: The type of consent. If you have more than one ConsentType, you may define additional columns with the appropriate ConsentType. Each ConsentType may only be used once per DataSet.

CreateDataSetRequestContent.description: A request to create a new data set.

CreateDataSetResponseContent.description: A response containing the identifiers of the created data set.

dataSetId.description: The data set ID of the data set created.

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the instance.

CreateUploadRequestContent.description: A request to create a new upload to a data set.

countryCode.description: Optional. A field that specifies a country. Values corresponds to ISO-3166 codes for country definitions. Required to resolve provided identities.

CreateUploadResponseContent.description: A response containing information about the upload.

uploadId.description: The ID of the upload request.

warnings.description: A list of warnings associated with the upload creation.

CreateUserDeletionRequestRequestContent.description: A request to delete some user identities from previously uploaded data.

targetIdentities.description: Identities to be deleted. Max number of identities to delete is 1,000 per request.

CreateUserDeletionRequestResponseContent.description: A response containing information about the deletion request.

userDeletionRequestId.description: The request ID of the user deletion request.

CsvDataFormat.description: Represents a CSV data format, and the values needed to ingest the source CSV file.

commentCharacter.description: Optional. String representing the comment character for a CSV file. Default is none.

fieldDelimiter.description: Optional. String representing the field delimiter for a CSV file. Default is `,`.

quoteCharacter.description: Optional. String representing the quote character for a CSV file. Default is `"`.

quoteEscapeCharacter.description: Optional. String representing the quote escape character for a CSV file. Default is `\`.

recordDelimiter.description: Optional. String representing the record delimiter for a CSV file. Default is `\n`.

CustomerDataSource.description: Describes the source of the data. Exactly one of `sourceManifestS3Key`, `sourceFileS3Key`, or `sourceS3Prefix` must be provided.

sourceFileS3Key.description: S3 key of the single object to upload.

sourceManifestS3Key.description: S3 key of the manifest containing the object(s) to upload.

sourceS3Bucket.description: S3 bucket that is the source of the upload.

sourceS3Prefix.description: S3 key prefix containing the object(s) to upload.

DataSet.description: The definition of a data set.

columns.description: A list of data set columns.

countryCode.description: Optional. A field that specifies a country. Values corresponds to ISO-3166 codes for country definitions. Required to resolve provided identities.

customerEncryptionKeyArn.description: Optional. If the data being uploaded is encrypted with a customer-managed encryption key, the ARN of said encryption key.

dataSetId.description: The unique identifier of the data set. Used to query the data set. Cannot contain spaces.

description.description: Optional. The human-readable description of the data set.

warnings.description: A list of warnings associated with the data set.

DataType.description: The data type for the data stored in this column.

DeleteColumnFromDataSetResponseContent.description: A response containing the updated data set without the deleted column.

DeleteDataSetResponseContent.description: A response containing identifiers of the deleted data set.

dataSetId.description: The data set ID of the deleted data set.

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the instance.

ExternalIdentity.description: Representation of an External Identity to be removed. Contains the type of the ID, and the String value of the ID.

ExternalIdentityType.description: The external ID types that we support.

FileFormat.description: The format in which data to be uploaded is stored. Exactly one of `csvDataFormat`, `jsonDataFormat`, or `parquetDataFormat` must be provided.

HashedIdentity.description: One or more pairs of a Hashed PII type and corresponding hashed value, representing a single individual to be deleted.

Identity.description: The user identity to be deleted. Either an ExternalId or a collection of Hashed PII values representing a single user.

ListDataSetsResponseContent.description: A response containing a list of data sets for the specified instance.

dataSets.description: The list of data sets returned by the request.

nextToken.description: Optional. Token to use in subsequent request to retrieve next page of results. Null if all results have been returned.

ListUploadsResponseContent.description: A response containing a list of uploads for the specified instance.

nextToken.description: Optional. Token to use in subsequent request to retrieve next page of results. Null if all results have been returned.

additionalProperties.description: The numerical value of the metric.

MetricsMap.description: A map containing metrics about an upload, where the key is the name of the metric and the value is a double representing the numerical value of said metric.

ParquetDataFormat.description: Represents a Parquet data format, and the values needed to ingest the source Parquet file.

PlaintextIdentity.description: One or more pairs of a Plaintext PII type and corresponding plaintext value, representing a single individual to be deleted.

UpdateColumnInDataSetRequestContent.description: A request to update a column in a data set.

UpdateColumnInDataSetResponseContent.description: A response containing the updated data set containing the updated column.

UpdateDataSetRequestContent.description: A request to update a data set definition.

countryCode.description: Optional. A field that specifies a country. Values corresponds to ISO-3166 codes for country definitions. Required to resolve provided identities.

description.description: Optional. An updated description of the data set defintion.

UpdateDataSetResponseContent.description: A response containing the updated data set definition.

UpdateStrategy.description: Represents the update strategy to be used when updating the data set.

Upload.description: The available metadata about a previously submitted upload.

countryCode.description: Optional. A field that specifies a country. Values corresponds to ISO-3166 codes for country definitions. Required to resolve provided identities.

createdAt.description: A timestamp representing the time the upload was created.

dataSetId.description: The data set ID of the upload.

instanceId.description: The instance ID of the upload.

message.description: A message specifying details of the upload. This is usually an error message describing a failure.

updatedAt.description: A timestamp representing the last time the upload was updated.

uploadId.description: The unique identifier for an upload.

warnings.description: A list of warnings associated with the upload.

UserDeletion.description: The available metadata about a previously submitted user deletion request.

creationDateTime.description: A timestamp representing the time the user deletion request was created. This field is in UTC and is formatted as yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'.

identityCount.description: The number of identities requested for user deletion.

userDeletionRequestId.description: The request ID of the user deletion request.

UserIdType.description: Specifies the type of an identity. An identity column may represent either a single hashed PII attribute, or an external identity in one of the supported identity spaces.
